engineeringSkip.reason: A buzzword mash-up describing a 'sentient' planetary management system whose core premise — using quantum entanglement for zero-latency global signalling — is impossible, since entanglement cannot transmit information.

factCheck.reason: It strings together real words — 6G, sentient AI, quantum entanglement — into a planetary 'operating system', but entangled particles cannot carry signals faster than light, so the zero-latency global sync it depends on is impossible under known physics.
